dedupe_keys.name: thermal and electrical energy demands from energy meters and measured values from sensors in an air handling unit and in the served lecture room of an university building

description: Thomas Messervey and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. This Galway university-building collection provides measured heat delivered to the western distribution loop, daily chiller electricity, and detailed air-handling-unit, outdoor and lecture-room states. Heating-loop measurements run from April 2018 to February 2019 at one-minute intervals. Daily chiller values and minute-level environmental/air-handling measurements run from January 2018 to February 2019. The source establishes BMS extraction through BEMServer and supplies an attached variable inventory. The measurements support physical building-energy and HVAC model inputs and validation. No inference is made that every building zone or every operating variable has equal coverage. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cdla-permissive-1.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
